name: basecraft
description: Basecraft - an independently branded, self-hostable structured-data workspace (Airtable-style alternative)

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
